node.title: Re: mystery: Devel::Cover showing missing statement coverage on a line that is being run
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I can confirm the same results, and it looks like a bug to me. The minimal test case I was able to reduce it to is { sub x {} } x() (a [doc://print] can be inserted into the sub to prove it actually does run). The [https://github.com/pjcj/Devel--Cover/issues|issue] [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Dist/Display.html?Name=Devel-Cover|trackers] contain a few bugs for similar kinds of issues where coverage is not reported correctly, so you may want to open a new bug report.
